summary: Prudential plc filed a 6-K disclosing an on-market share repurchase of 265,592 ordinary shares at an average price of £11.0066 per share, with a volume-weighted average price of £11.0066, executed via JP Morgan Securities plc. The repurchase is authorized under the 2025 AGM and an arrangement announced 6 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled, reducing share count to 2,519,852,767. The transaction is reported under UK and Hong Kong buy-back rules. This is a routine capital return program; no premium, board recommendation, or advisor is cited. Watch for continued execution and cancellation impact on EPS.
